note: 内置示例插件清单。App 的「插件」页会读这个文件，让你一键安装。新增示例时只要把 json 放进本目录并在这里加一行。

examples.name: 选择题
examples.desc: 正面只给题干和选项，背面自动高亮正确项并给出解析。选项一行一个，正确的那行用 * 开头。

en.name: Multiple choice
en.desc: The front shows only the question and the options; the back automatically highlights the correct option and shows the explanation. One option per line — the correct line starts with *.

examples.name: 英语单词
examples.desc: 音标、词性、释义、例句与词根一起记。AI 能一次生成一整套字段。

en.name: English vocabulary
en.desc: Phonetic, part of speech, meaning, example and roots all in one card. AI can generate the whole set at once.

examples.name: 法条挖空
examples.desc: 把要件、数额、期限挖出来背。AI 只挖关键处，其余原文逐字保留。

en.name: Statute cloze
en.desc: Cloze out the elements, amounts and deadlines you must memorise. AI blanks only the key parts and keeps the rest of the text verbatim.

examples.name: 代码 / API 记忆
examples.desc: 签名、返回值、示例、易错点。适合背 API 和语法细节。

en.name: Code / API memory
en.desc: Signature, return value, example, pitfalls. Great for memorising APIs and syntax details.

examples.name: 空白模板（自己改）
examples.desc: 最小的可用骨架，装完点「查看/编辑 JSON」照着写自己的卡型。

en.name: Blank template (edit it yourself)
en.desc: The smallest working skeleton. After installing it, tap "View / edit JSON" and write your own card type from there.
